speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

The combination of fever, altered mentation, generalized rigidity, and profuse sweating in a patient on haloperidol is classic for NMS. The normal reflexes and ability to move all limbs help distinguish this from serotonin syndrome or other causes of altered mental status.
